title.narrative: LIFE: Lifesaving Interventions for Food, Health, and Protection in Deir ez-Zor

description.narrative: ltpgtDorcas will intervene in Deir Ezzor by targeting three key sectors: protection, health, and food security, in alignment with the allocation strategy.ltbrgtDorcas will operate a mobile health unit to provide essential healthcare services to underserved villages. This unit will offer medical consultations, distribute medicines, and rotate between different locations in Deir Ezzor to ensure broad coverage where primary healthcare services are not readily available. The mobile unit will also conduct health awareness and education sessions, focusing on preventive measures, hygiene ltspangtmaternal child health, disease prevention including water borne diseaseslt/spangtltspangt. lt/spangtltspangtDorcas will also provide medical equipment to the DOH of Deir Ezzor to be distributed to the hospitals in the area. lt/spangtltspangtThe estimated reach is 12500.lt/spangtltspangt lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtTo combat food insecurity, Dorcas will support 400 vulnerable households by distributing food parcels eight times throughout the intervention period. Each parcel will be designed to meet the nutritional needs of the recipients, ensuring a balanced diet that includes staples, proteins, and essential vitamins. This initiative aims to alleviate immediate food shortages and improve the nutritional status of the most vulnerable populations, including families with children, older persons, and those with disabilities. The distribution process will be monitored to ensure fairness and transparency, with special consideration given to households led by women.ltbrgtDorcas will establish a community center (CC) in DZ mainly in Al Koussour serving Al Joura neighborhood based on the recommendations of the CP sector, which will serve as a hub for protection services, focusing on child protection, gender-based violence (GBV), psychosocial support (PSS). The center will offer comprehensive case management services to address the needs of vulnerable individuals. For CP, the center will provide safe spaces for children, offer educational and recreational activities, and work to prevent and respond to abuse, neglect, and exploitation.ltbrgtIn addressing GBV, the CC will include a dedicated safe room for women and girls, providing a secure and confidential space for case management and support services. The center will also distribute GBV kits to women and girls participating in its activities, which will include essential items to support their safety and well-being, it will also provide PSS kits for boys. Additionally, the center will conduct awareness sessions on GBV prevention and response, equipping community members with the knowledge and resources to protect themselves and others. The target for protection activities is around 2,000 individuals as some of them will receive several services. ltbrgtAs part of its holistic approach, Dorcas will invest in capacity building for local staff working at the CC and in the mobile unit in addition to the staff of DOH with whom Dorcas will be collaborating. Training sessions will be conducted on protection principles, early identification and referral mechanisms, and effective case management practices, in addition to health related topics. By enhancing the skills and knowledge of local stakeholders, Dorcas aims to ensure the sustainability of its interventions and empower the community to continue these efforts beyond the project’s duration.ltbrgtDorcas will implement a robust monitoring and evaluation framework to track the progress and impact of its interventions. Regular site visits, beneficiary feedback surveys, focus group discussions, and post-distribution monitoring will be conducted to ensure accountability and measure outcomes. This data will be used to refine and adapt the project activities, ensuring they remain responsive to the needs of the community.ltbrgtThese planned interventions aim to address critical needs in Deir Ezzor, enhancing the well-being and resilience of vulnerable communities. Dorcas will provide comprehensive support to those most in need, enabling a safer and more supportive environment for all.ltbrgtlt/pgt
